name: The Curious Alliance
source:
Since receiving his Summoner's amulet, Albert has searched through out the empire for remnant artifacts of the previous civilization, accompanied by his companion demon Neph. The two arrive in the remote town of Ravensford on the rumor of such an artifact, but find the town haunted by the vampire Darien von Creighton.

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=5296]Lemmasoft Forums[/url]]
translation:
自从获得召唤师护符以来，Albert便在同伴恶魔Neph的陪伴下走遍帝国各地，寻找前代文明遗留的文物。两人听闻偏远小镇Ravensford存在这样一件文物，便来到此地，却发现小镇正受吸血鬼Darien von Creighton纠缠。

[摘自[url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=5296]Lemmasoft Forums[/url]]
